outline.h2: How we chose these Oceania destinations
outline.answers: Must-include (01-brief): unranked, grouped by region, official sources only, guide gaps said plainly; related search 'Best oceania wedding destinations' (Melbourne) answered without ranking
outline.notes: Sits after the direct answer intro and the 4 one-sentence takeaways (intro has no H2). One short paragraph. LINK comment for /destination-weddings/wedding-destinations-november (404 today, draft). WMO care-when-comparing remark only if oc_a confirms the wording.

outline.answers: Secondary 'fiji wedding' (AU 720/month) and 'vanuatu wedding' (AU 90); SERP angle 'South Pacific islands' venue lists (myweddingguide.co.nz x4 in Sydney and Melbourne); must-include group Melanesia
outline.notes: Entry template per 01-brief (why it suits or the trade-off; when to go; getting married there; two venue questions; our guide). Fiji links /destinations/oceania/fiji only (/magazine/fiji/get-wedded-in-fiji canonicalises to the Fiji hub, do not add it). Vanuatu and New Caledonia link no guide of ours; we do own an old article /top-5-vanuatu-wedding-venues-for-a-tropical-destination-wedding (venue names, ranks 50 to 67 for vanuatu package terms): do not link it. New Caledonia advice level quoted exactly from Smartraveller as at November 2026. Entry sub labels are bold text, not headings; if the CMS makes them H4, no colons.

outline.answers: Secondary 'tahiti wedding' (AU 30, US 90), 'samoa wedding' (AU 70, US 50), 'cook islands wedding' (AU 30); SERP snippets name Tahiti and Moorea, Rarotonga and Aitutaki (marieclaire.com.au, goway.com, Facebook answer); must-include group Polynesia
outline.notes: Only Hawaii links a guide (/destination-weddings/getting-married-in-hawaii). Hawaii said plainly to be north of the equator and a US state. Samoa may carry the cultural read /a-traditional-samoan-wedding-celebration (real wedding, live, index follow) plus the LINK comment for /expert-advice/samoan-wedding-traditions (404 today). Do not let the Samoa entry chase 'samoan wedding': our traditions pages already rank for it.

outline.h2: New Zealand for a wedding in four seasons
outline.answers: Must-include group New Zealand; Melbourne and Sydney SERPs show NZ venue directories (myweddingguide.co.nz) for Pacific queries
outline.notes: Temperate, not tropical. Legal lines only from the NZ guide's pack; link /destination-weddings/get-married-in-new-zealand (live, index follow, modified 2026-11-18).

outline.answers: Sydney SERP for the primary keyword is half Australian beach intent (newlywed.com.au #2 and #8 name Byron Bay and the Whitsunday Islands); related searches 'oceania wedding destinations near sydney nsw / near melbourne vic'
h3: The Whitsundays and the Great Barrier Reef islands
outline.notes: Link the Hayman guide with an anchor that names no resort (its title and description name the resort, so the anchor says 'our Whitsundays island guide'). One line for mainland couples to /best-wedding-spots-in-byron-bay (anchor without 'best') and /au/venues-in-sydney. Legal line links /expert-advice/notice-of-intended-marriage-explained-step-by-step and /expert-advice/who-can-perform-a-marriage.

outline.h2: Oceania wedding destinations at a glance

outline.notes: Columns per 01-brief: Destination, Region, Wet or cyclone season (as the source states it), Getting married, Our guide (link or 'not yet'). Values match entries exactly.
